company.name: inHovate Solutions
company.shortDescription: inHovate Solutions is a technology company that provides an intelligent cloud-based platform designed to help hospitality businesses.
company.description: Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Dubai / Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, the company develops a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solution that integrates data from multiple hospitality systems—such as property management systems (PMS), point-of-sale systems (POS), ERP, and other internal and external data sources—into a unified platform. This allows hotel owners, operators, investors, and asset managers to gain real-time insights into their business performance.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,364,983 to $19,345,941, a 2.63x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 66 (-3 over 90 days) and market heat at 61 (-10).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
